identity.description:
Finish D5: six-label goldens, raw recall, adjudicated extras, cost per PR

## Spec

Finishes the four remaining bullets of "## D5: Eval foundation" in TICKETS.md. Version 0.4.0.

**R1 Six-label goldens.** The golden schema accepts the six labels of the severity policy. A golden labeled blocking, suggestion or nit is a posted golden; one labeled dont_post, not_real or unsure is a not-real golden. Recall and severity agreement count posted goldens only. A posted finding that matches a not-real golden is a false positive, counted in `not_real_matches`; the posted goldens get their matches first, so a posted golden wins over a not-real golden. `pr-review label --write-golden` writes every chosen label. The policy sentence that limited a golden to the three posted labels is replaced. In the cases repo, the 28 `not-real.json` findings moved into `golden.json` (jerridan/pr-review-cases branch `six-label-goldens`, 57 goldens: 29 posted, 28 not-real); `eval/cases.json` pins that commit, db6ad8e, so the cases branch waits for a merge by the owner.

**R2 Raw recall and drops.** The eval scores the union of `stages.reviewers[].findings` against the goldens with the same two passes, reusing judge answers of pairs the posted pass already judged. It reports `raw_recall`, `raw_matched`, `raw_candidates` and `drops` (the dropped rows of `explain` by stage) per repeat and in the aggregate, and prints `raw recall` and `drops` columns.

**R3 Adjudicated extras.** Every posted finding that matches no golden goes to the extras judge, a new prompt `prompts/extras-judge.md` (role judge) with the finding, the head window, the diff section of its file and the full policy as data blocks. The eval reports strict `precision` and `adjudicated_precision`, writes accepted extras to `<out>/<case>/candidates.json` in the golden format (one file per case, deduped on file, span and claim), never changes golden.json, and `--no-extras` turns it off.

**R4 Cost per PR.** Every repeat row shows `cost` and `judge cost`; the summary shows `cost per PR` and `judge cost per PR`; report.json carries `judge_cost_per_case`. `eval/baseline.json` gains the `tool_version` key that `BaselineSchema` requires and that the hand-written file lacked; its values stand, and `cases_ref` moves to the new pin.

## Decisions

- Path: change path; four packages, one pr-review territory at deep band (the schema is the data shape every metric reads) and one cases-repo territory. Spec critic two rounds (13 of 13 findings and 8 of 8 applied), split critic two rounds (6 of 6 and 3 of 3 applied).
- `--no-extras` and `<out>/<case>/candidates.json` chosen on recommendation, reversible.
- The cases change sits on a pushed branch, not main; the pin names its head so `fetch-cases.sh` reaches it before the merge.
- `--write-golden` writes the severity only; the category stays, as the labeler review decided.
- The baseline keeps recall 0.287 and precision 0.636: the six-label goldens change neither the posted-golden denominator nor the strict matches. `tool_version` is 0.3.1, the run that produced them.
- `test/prompt-sources.test.ts` joined p2's file set: its judge-query count rose from 2 to 6 by design (the raw pass).

## Verification

Every package: red commit fails, head passes, `npm test` (1211), lint, typecheck, build exit 0, diff inside the file set. On the branch head: `scripts/check-version-bump.sh` passes; `node dist/cli.js eval --cases eval/cases --tier skip --repeat 1` exits 0 over the ten pinned cases and prints the new columns; `loadCases` gives 10 cases, 57 goldens, 29 posted; the stale-status sweep finds nothing.

Crew record: `~/.claude/crew/d5-eval-foundation-finish-7f3a/`.

triage.summary: The change extends the eval with six-label goldens (not-real goldens count as false positives and are excluded from recall), raw-candidate recall, per-stage drop counts, and an extras judge that adjudicates unmatched posted findings and writes accepted ones to candidates.json. It adds --no-extras and --raw-judge flags, new report columns and metrics, makes `label --write-golden` write all six labels, and bumps versions, the cases ref and the CI eval command. Tests and docs are updated to match.
